title: Implement secure username/password authentication with registration

requirements.text: Replace hardcoded admin credentials in frontend/src/hooks/useAuth.ts with a secure registration system that allows creating new admin accounts

quotes: A proper user registration system where I create my own account

acceptanceCriteria: Remove hardcoded credentials (admin/admin123) from useAuth.ts
Add registration form UI with username, password, and password confirmation fields
Validate password strength (minimum 8 characters, mix of letters and numbers)
Prevent duplicate usernames during registration
Display success message after successful registration

requirements.text: Implement password hashing in the backend using SHA-256 or Motoko's native crypto functions to never store passwords in plain text

quotes: Password hashing (never storing passwords in plain text)

acceptanceCriteria: Hash all passwords before storing in backend state
Use salt with each password hash for additional security
Verify passwords by comparing hashed values during login
Never expose plain text passwords in any API response or log

requirements.text: Create backend user management functions in backend/main.mo for registering users, authenticating with hashed passwords, and managing user accounts

quotes: A proper user registration system where I create my own account

acceptanceCriteria: Add registerUser function that accepts username and password, hashes the password, and stores the user
Add authenticateUser function that verifies username and hashed password
Store users in stable storage to persist across upgrades
Return appropriate error messages for duplicate usernames or invalid credentials

requirements.text: Implement secure session management with token-based authentication that expires after a reasonable period
acceptanceCriteria: Generate secure session tokens upon successful login
Store session tokens securely in the backend with expiration timestamps
Set session expiration to 24 hours by default
Validate session tokens on protected endpoints
Clear expired sessions automatically
Provide logout functionality that invalidates the session token

requirements.text: Update AdminLogin component in frontend/src/components/AdminLogin.tsx to include registration UI and connect to the new backend authentication system

quotes: A proper user registration system where I create my own account

acceptanceCriteria: Add toggle between login and registration modes
Display registration form with username, password, and confirm password fields
Show password strength indicator
Handle registration errors (duplicate username, weak password)
Automatically log in user after successful registration

constraints: Preserve existing Internet Identity authentication option alongside new username/password system
Do not modify Internet Identity authentication logic in useInternetIdentity.ts
Maintain existing role-based access control for admin panel
Keep current product management functionality intact
nonGoals: Adding OAuth or social login options
